reviewer: Assistant manual semantic/readability review of every actual input/raw-output pair. Synthetic development screen only; no fresh holdout inspected. Reviewer implemented prompt helpers; this is not a blinded human study.
scope: Native complete raw responses before Core fallback; benign outer whitespace trimming is permitted and does not excuse changes within protected payloads. No Windows/whole-app SLA claim.
contract_review: Exact model-specific task prefix, prompt, greedy decoding and fixed tokenization contract. ScribeKey uses its evaluated semi-casual condition, distinct from S1 semi-formal. No format mismatch identified.

definitions.faithful: Retains intended facts, speech act, uncertainty, tone, quoted wording and exact protected dictionary literals. Harmless quote punctuation is assessed separately from lexical/semantic harm.
definitions.edit_needed: Human judgment that Core-normalized baseline needs cleanup; excludes benign alternative wording and already normalized numbers.
definitions.useful: Faithful output makes a beneficial edit to the cleanup problem; cosmetic punctuation alone does not count when the required correction remains. Partial useful filler/correction edits can count; see cleanup_complete.
definitions.cleanup_complete: Meets intended cleanup at adequate fidelity; preserves no-edit text acceptably. Minor punctuation alternatives do not fail this judgment.
definitions.acceptable: Faithful, fully cleaned where needed, and readable plain text. Clear malformed punctuation remains a formatting failure without being labeled semantic loss.
